manifest.selection_principle:
Tickers selected for axis-diversity coverage per Constitution v2.0 §22.
Selection criteria are objective: industry coverage, expected axis pass
distribution, segment-reporting structure (single vs multi-segment for
§13). NO ticker is included because of user preference, recent
performance, or analyst opinion. Negative controls and conglomerate
edge cases are intentionally included so the rubric is exercised in
both directions.

entries.rationale: Beverages — long-cited brand-moat exemplar; ROIC advantage detection
Software platforms — switching-cost moat; stable ROIC
Payment networks — two-sided network moat
Credit ratings — regulatory + reputation moat
Leading-edge fab process — technical bottleneck pure-play (NOTE: Finnhub financials-reported coverage gap, see manifest header)
